name: Sneaker Reveal
description: Before and after image comparison where a dirty sneaker photo is wiped away over a clean one by following the pointer, with a draggable-looking divider handle and caption.
contents: Clean image with a dirty image layered on top and clipped
Divider line with circular arrow handle
Brand line and tagline caption, thin accent bars at top and bottom
behavior: Divider follows the pointer horizontally with eased friction while hovering
Eases back to the center when the pointer leaves
editableByProps: Both images, alt text, labels, brand and tagline
Accent, background and muted text colors

h-[3px] divs at the top and bottom of main

fixed: Root is absolutely positioned and fills its nearest positioned parent
